PROFILEEnterprise Account Manager with 6+ years of experience driving enterprise growth across AI, SaaS, Digital Engineering, IT Consulting, andBanking. Developed 20+ executive presentations, solution proposals, and strategic account plans tailored to customer business objectives.

Collaborated with product, engineering, and delivery teams to design AI-led automation solutions across healthcare,manufacturing, travel, retail, and BFSI.

Managed an active pipeline of 15+ enterprise opportunities, providing weekly forecasting, deal reviews, and executive updates.

Built relationships with decision-makers across Global Capability Centers (GCCs) and enterprises in the travel and BFSI sectors,expanding Sash.AI's enterprise outreach in India and Europe.

Managed ₹12 Cr+ Enterprise Portfolio

Conducted market research across 100+ enterprise prospects, identifying buying signals, competitive insights, and new businessopportunities.

Developed 15+ executive presentations, solution proposals, and account recommendations tailored to customer business objectives.

Coordinated 5+ cross-functional teams, including delivery, engineering, marketing, and client stakeholders to execute enterprisecustomer initiatives.

Improved lead conversion by 25% through structured account planning, personalized outreach, and consultative engagement.
